title: RB=F gasoline z-score vs JETS/SPY ratio
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] RB=F gasoline futures 10d z-score > 1.5 keeps airlines lagging SPY for over a week (-); trade short JETS vs SPY 8d at 0d lag [finance.RB=F.close -> finance.ratio.jets_spy]
message: Supported in-sample (r=-0.34, n=389, perm p=0.036 but Bonferroni p=0.75); short JETS/SPY on RB=F level z>1 gave 49 trades, hit 55%, +0.11%/trade, but war-period test negative (17 trades, -0.18%/trade); actionability 4.3 - story more than rule.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.RB=F.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short ratio:jets_spy next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] RB=F gasoline daily log returns 20d z-score > 1 lead JETS/SPY ratio lower by 1-3 days (-); stationary-returns control of R2-0077 whose level rule fit pre-war (hit 56%) but lost out-of-sample in the war test; trade short JETS vs SPY 3d [finance.RB=F.log_return -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0077)
